settings.heroBannerText: Free shipping on orders over Rs. 5,000 · Cash on Delivery available nationwide

faqs.question: Delivery mein kitne din lagte hain?
faqs.answer: Karachi, Lahore aur Islamabad mein 1-3 business days, aur baqi Pakistan mein 3-5 business days lagte hain.

faqs.question: Shipping charges kitne hain aur kab free hoti hai?
faqs.answer: Shipping city ke hisab se Rs. 200 se Rs. 350 tak hai. Rs. 5,000 se zyada ke order par shipping free hai.

faqs.question: Kya order track kiya ja sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Order place karne ke baad aapko ek order ID milta hai. Confirmation page par order ka status (Processing/Shipped/Delivered) dekha ja sakta hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap Pakistan ke sab shehron mein deliver karte hain?
faqs.answer: Ji haan, hum Pakistan ke tamam bade aur chote shehron mein delivery karte hain.

faqs.question: Kaunse payment methods available hain?
faqs.answer: Cash on Delivery (COD), JazzCash aur EasyPaisa se payment kar sakte hain. Debit/Credit card jald hi available hoga.

faqs.question: Kya COD pe extra charges lagte hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi, Cash on Delivery par koi extra charges nahi hain — sirf shipping fee lagti hai.

faqs.question: Promo code kaise use karein?
faqs.answer: Cart page par 'Promo code' box mein apna code likh kar Apply par click karein, discount total mein turant nazar aa jayega.

faqs.question: Return/exchange policy kya hai?
faqs.answer: Delivery ke 7 din ke andar, agar item unworn hai aur tags laga hua hai, to aap use return ya exchange kar sakte hain.

faqs.question: Size fit nahi aaya to kya karein?
faqs.answer: Hamare WhatsApp number par contact karein — hum size exchange ka process free mein guide karenge.

faqs.question: Sahi size kaise choose karein?
faqs.answer: Har product page par 'Size chart' link diya gaya hai jahan chest, waist aur length ki exact measurements mil jayengi.

faqs.question: Order place karne ke liye account banana zaroori hai kya?
faqs.answer: Nahi, StyleHub par guest checkout available hai — bina account banaye bhi order place kiya ja sakta hai.

returns.intro: We want you to love what you ordered. If something isn't right, here's how returns and exchanges work at StyleHub.
rules: Items can be returned or exchanged within 7 days of delivery.
Item must be unworn, unwashed, and with original tags attached.
Footwear must be returned in its original box, undamaged.
Sale/clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged, unless defective.
To start a return or exchange, contact us on WhatsApp with your order ID.
Refunds for COD orders are processed via bank transfer within 5-7 business days after we receive the item.
Exchange for a different size is free — no additional shipping charge.
Items damaged due to normal wear, misuse, or alteration are not eligible for return.

shipping.intro: We ship across Pakistan. Here's what to expect on delivery times, charges, and tracking.
rules: All other cities in Pakistan: 3-5 business days.
Shipping charges range from Rs. 200-350 depending on your city, calculated automatically at checkout.
Orders over Rs. 5,000 qualify for free shipping.
Cash on Delivery (COD) is available nationwide with no extra charge.
You'll receive an order ID at checkout — order status can be viewed on the confirmation page.
Orders are processed within 24 hours on business days (Mon-Sat).
We currently do not ship internationally.
